name: Mip-NeRF Network Architecture
definition: A smaller but more efficient fully-connected multilayer perceptron (MLP) network for neural radiance fields that uses positional encoding for input points and viewing directions, designed to be more efficient than the original NeRF architecture.
summary: The Mip-NeRF Network Architecture is a smaller, more efficient MLP variant of NeRF with reduced hidden layers, optimized for depth-assisted training.
